title: Signal Processing Summit
text: Signal Processing Summit 2027 | Silicon Valley, Jan 26-28 and online Feb 9-11 About Speakers Program Pricing Location Speak Silicon Valley · January 26-28, 2027 and online · February 9-11, 2027 Register now ▼ Welcome back to the Signal Processing Summit Explore the future of signal-processing technologies powering AI, wireless, vision, audio, embedded systems, and more. After an inaugural edition that brought the community together in Silicon Valley, the team behind DSPRelated.com and the DSP Online Conference is back for a second Summit. Three days in person, January 26-28, with the talks also reaching a worldwide audience online at the DSP Online Conference, February 9-11. Meet the 2027 speakers See pricing Featuring fred harris Two 2-hour sessions • January 26-28 • In person The author of Multirate Signal Processing for Communication Systems returns to the Summit with two extended sessions: one broad enough for every signal processing engineer in the room, one that goes deep. Titles to be announced. The Thursday AI workshop is included in All Access only (or in the ESS AI Workshop Day pass). Add the DSP Online Conference, February 9-11, 2027, to any pass for $95 at checkout. Why Attend? Engineers that invest in their continuous education outperform the rest. 01 Learn from Industry Leaders Learn from the innovators shaping the field. Go beyond presentations. Engage directly with the brightest minds and leading luminaries in Signal Processing. 02 Networking on Steroids! Forge powerful new connections with peers, experts, and potential collaborators. This is your chance to expand your professional circle and uncover opportunities that could shape your career. 03 Content Engineered by Engineers, for Engineers Forget the fluff. As engineers ourselves, we've designed a program with a singularly high "signal-to-noise ratio." Expect only relevant, high-quality, and immediately applicable training that addresses your real-world challenges. 04 Ignite Your Inspiration & Supercharge Your Skills Recharge your passion for signal processing. Leave the Summit energized and empowered with cutting-edge knowledge and practical takeaways you can immediately apply to your projects. This isn't just learning, it's an investment in your future success. What it looked like last time Scenes from the 2025 edition in Silicon Valley. A single track, a room you can ask questions in, and conversations that carry on into the hallway. Co-located with the Embedded Systems Summit Two summits, one venue, one badge. The Embedded Systems Summit runs alongside SPS on the same three days, and any pass gets you into both talk tracks on the days it covers. Move between rooms as the program suits you. Curious about who your hosts will be? Meet Your Hosts WHERE? Sonesta Silicon Valley, California The Signal Processing Summit returns to the Sonesta Silicon Valley in Milpitas, California, the same venue that hosted our inaugural edition. The hotel offers comfortable guest rooms on the same property as the conference rooms. It's also about 5 miles from San Jose International Airport (SJC). Event dates January 26-28, 2027 Book your room We are finalizing the agreement with the hotel. The group rate and the booking link will be posted here shortly, and we will email everyone who has registered as soon as they are live. There is no need to book now: rooms at this hotel in January are not in short supply, and booking before the group link opens would cost you more. Getting there Closest airport: San Jose (SJC). San Francisco (SFO) and Oakland (OAK) are alternatives. Parking: On-site self-parking available. Rideshare/taxi: Drop-off and pickup at the main entrance.
